decisions.reclaimed_water_plan: Use reclaimed water exclusively on Line Y for its scheduled batch. Do not use reclaimed water on Line X due to conductivity exceedance. The 3-hour membrane flush must be completed before reclaimed water delivery begins. Line Y's batch requires 1,800 liters, which at 600 L/hr delivery rate will take 3 hours after the flush is complete. Sanitizer must be adjusted to exactly 0.3 ppm and a signed sanitizer log is required for each day of use. The conductivity test must be officially recorded before reclaimed water is used on Line Y.
